mainText: Hello, Verona! At 3 AM, here is today's balanced dish. We are seeing overcast skies and 60 degrees near Verona City Hall under a third quarter moon. The Space Station passes overhead tonight, but unfortunately you won't be able to see it due to the clouds.

In city updates, Verona welcomes Liz Gay as the new EMS Deputy Chief of Administration. Additionally, Public Works announced street pavement repairs beginning November 9th along Nine Mound Road, Morningside Boulevard, and Mozart Street.

For local outings, enjoy Yoga at Insight Wellness or live music at Paddy Mac's happening today. Tomorrow, ART House 360 hosts its Thursday night social hour and comedy, and Hop Haus Trivia takes place tomorrow evening.
In the weekly police recap, on Wednesday, October 21st, officers responded to a domestic disturbance on Church Avenue where a Madison woman was arrested for disorderly conduct.
Over at Culver's, today's flavor of the day is Dark Chocolate PB Crunch. The restaurant opens today at 10:00 AM to satisfy your sweet tooth.
